title: 12 · put: update or append?
objective: Implement adding a mapping without duplicate keys.
instructions: put(head, key, value) returns the first Node after the operation.
If the key exists, update its value; do not create a duplicate.
If the key is new, append a Node at the end. If head is null, create head.
hints: Check for a null head before using .next.
Compare the current key before appending a node.
Do not move current all the way to null and then call current.next.
